thread:
elaine_sales: Quick heads-up - Mike in the POC hit auth errors trying to hit /v1/generate. Says keys were working yesterday but now 403 + 401 intermittently. Can we swarm? :eyes:
customer_mike: Hey team - reproducing: curl returns 403 with body 'org/project mismatch'. Using the key from the trial invite email.
sam_se: Can you paste the exact curl you used (remove actual key) and the full response body/headers?
customer_mike: Sure:
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc123\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1-large\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```
Response headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 0
X-Redwood-Error: org_mismatch

{\"error\":\"organization mismatch: request org=org_123, resource org=org_987\"}
```
elaine_sales: They mention the key was from the trial invite - sometimes those are tenant-scoped. Could be bound to a different org or project.
sam_se: Yep. Most likely the API key is bound to a different org/project or missing scopes. Two quick checks: 1) make sure you set X-Redwood-Org header (if using org-scoped keys) 2) check key metadata via our auth introspection endpoint.
matt_oncall: Run this (no real key in paste):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc123\" https://auth.redwood.example/v1/keys/introspect
```
That returns JSON like:
```
{\"key_id\":\"key_abc\",\"org_id\":\"org_987\",\"projects\":[\"proj-1\"],\"scopes\":[\"generate\",\"embed\"],\"expires_at\":null}
```
customer_mike: Introspect returned org_987 but our app is under org_123. How did the key become org_987? We never touched that org.
sam_se: Two possibilities: (a) the invite link the customer used created a new org and the key was generated there, or (b) the key is from a shared partner sandbox. If you want to use within org_123, we need to create a new key scoped to org_123/project or rebind it.
customer_mike: Ok how quick is that? We're mid-demo today.
elaine_sales: Sam, can we quickly issue a temp project key for org_123?
sam_se: I can create a short-lived service key with minimal scope. Need project ID and smallest scope you need. Mike, what calls do you need for the demo?
customer_mike: Just generate chat completions and embeddings for a quick QA flow - so scopes: chat:generate, embed:create.
sam_se: Understood. Matt - can you create a temp key in org_123 for proj-qa with those scopes and 1h TTL?
matt_oncall: Done. Created key sk_temp_demo_479 (rotated). I'm pasting a safe curl you can use (redacted):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_temp_demo_479\" \\
  -H \"X-Redwood-Org: org_123\" \\
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1-large\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
customer_mike: Success - 200, tokens returned. Thanks!! :tada:
customer_mike: One other thing - earlier we saw a 429 on a load test: body said 'rate limited' and Retry-After: 2. Could that be because of the temp key?
sam_se: No, rate limits are per-org/project and per-tier. For trial orgs we have conservative rate-limits. Details: 60 req/min per project by default in trial. If you need higher for the POC we can temporarily bump it.
elaine_sales: Pricing question from the buyer: if we move to Dedicated how are rate limits handled and what's the uplift? They'll want to know predictable throughput & cost.
sam_se: Dedicated gives you reserved throughput and higher per-minute token throughput; we have baseline packages (4k tokens/s, 8k tokens/s) and custom. I'll ping pricing to attach a brief. For POC bump, we can do a temporary increase for 24-72h.
security_arya: Quick security note: avoid pasting full keys in channel. Rotate after demo. For enterprise we recommend service account with SSO + KMS-wrapped keys. Also confirm that any key we issue is logged to audit trail.
matt_oncall: Noted. The temp key created has an audit entry and TTL set.
customer_mike: Thanks - can you also confirm that embeds call uses scope 'embed:create' - we got 403 earlier when hitting /v1/embeddings.
sam_se: Yes, embedding endpoints require embed:create scope. If you introspect your old key it probably lacked that. If you want, I can run a quick script to check scope coverage across your test suite.
customer_mike: Please do. Also what's the process to move to production keys tied to our SAML SSO?
elaine_sales: I'll follow up with the SSO KBA and enterprise onboarding doc. We can schedule a call with security_arya.
sam_se: Action items: 1) Mike uses sk_temp_demo_479 for demo (matt created) 2) sam to scan test suite for missing scopes 3) matt to request temporary rate limit bump if needed 4) elaine to send pricing + SSO next steps.
deploy_bot: [key-rotation] Created temp key sk_temp_demo_479 for org_123/proj-qa (expires in 1h).
customer_mike: All good on my side - demo passed. Will rotate keys at EOD. Thanks team!
elaine_sales: Great. If anything else pops up ping this thread. :thumbsup:
